events.info: Based on the iconic 1985 Paramount movie which was inspired by the classic Hasbro board game, CLUE is a hilarious farce-meets-murder mystery. The tale begins at a remote mansion, where six mysterious guests assemble for an unusual dinner party where murder and blackmail are on the menu. When their host turns up dead, they all become suspects. Led by the Wadsworth - the butler, Miss Scarlett, Professor Plum, Mrs. White, Mr. Green, Mrs. Peacock and Colonel Mustard race to find the killer as the body count stacks up. CLUE is the comedy whodunit that will leave both cult-fans and newcomers in stitches as they try to figure out... WHO did it, WHERE, and with WHAT! The show is adapted from the original Jonathan Lynn screenplay, by Sandy Rustin (The Cottage, Rated P... For Parenthood) with additional material by Hunter Foster (Jasper in Deadland, Summer of '42) and Eric Price (A Grand Night for Singing). CLUE features original underscoring by composer Michael Holland (Godspell).
events.pleaseNote: No refunds or exchanges. Event date and time subject to change. All ages are required to have a ticket for this event. Tickets subject to cancellation if suspected brokering or violating ticket limits. The Tennessee Theatre is not responsible for any tickets that are lost, stolen, or purchased through third party websites. Free parking available on weekends and after 6pm on weekdays in the State Street Garage behind the Theatre. For the safety of all patrons, all persons and items entering the Theatre are subject to screening by security officers and metal detectors. Prohibited items: weapons of any kind (including pocketknives), Illegal substances, cameras, audio or video recording devices (photo policy subject to change per event). Patrons who fail to comply will not be admitted into the venue or will be expelled from the venue without refund. Tickets will be available approximately 24 hours before the event.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness.

events.info: Fresh off the release of Magic Lover - Netflix's first-ever magic comedy special - Justin Willman is hitting the road with an all-new tour: One for the Ages. Willman is best known as the star and creator of Netflix's Magic for Humans and Magic Prank Show, where his signature mix of mind-blowing magic and relatable humor has made him a streaming favorite, a viral hit (1 billion views and counting), and a fan favorite for families, comedy lovers, and skeptics alike. He's appeared on The Tonight Show, The Today Show, The Kelly Clarkson Show, and Conan, and was recently named "Stage Magician of the Year" by the Magic Castle. He's performed at the White House, packed theaters across the country, and managed to make grown adults openly weep over a card trick. But the live show? That's where the real magic happens. This show is most appropriate for ages 8+
events.pleaseNote: This show is most appropriate for ages 8+ No refunds or exchanges. Event date and time subject to change. All ages are required to have a ticket for this event. Tickets subject to cancellation if suspected brokering or violating ticket limits. The Tennessee Theatre is not responsible for any tickets that are lost, stolen, or purchased through third party websites. Free parking available on weekends and after 6pm on weekdays in the State Street Garage behind the Theatre. For the safety of all patrons, all persons and items entering the Theatre are subject to screening by security officers and metal detectors. Prohibited items: weapons of any kind (including pocketknives), Illegal substances, cameras, audio or video recording devices (photo policy subject to change per event). Patrons who fail to comply will not be admitted into the venue or will be expelled from the venue without refund.

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 8 ticket limit for this event.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Friday 10:00am-3:00pm. Day of event - Will Call is available 1 hour prior to the start of performance
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tennessee Theatre is a digital ticketing venue. The Box Office will be available 1 hour prior to performance to assist with ticketing needs.

venues.parkingDetail: Free parking is available for most night and weekend performances at the State Street garage located behind the theater, as well as the nearby Locust Street and Market Square garages. Additional parking lots and on-street parking are located nearby. For performances during regular business hours, parking is available in all of these areas for a fee. Parking fees vary from lot to lot. Please allow ample time to park.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The venue has ADA seating in various locations. Please call venue Box Office for these. Venue has Elevators, and ADA Facilities, ADA Parking, ADA ramps and Entrance. For more info call 865-684-1200 ext. 2.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras, camera phones, audio, video and digital recorders, paging devices, and cell phones may not be permitted in the theatres based on the artists' policies. Guests using prohibited items may be ejected without refund.
generalInfo.childRule: All attendees, regardless of age, are required to hold a ticket. This applies to children who may sit on an adult's lap for the majority or entirety of a performance. For question, please contact the Box Office.

events.info: The Tony Award-winning play explodes with dark comedy and ferocious family drama when the Lafayette family gathers to settle their father's estate - only to uncover a shocking secret that sends their reunion spiraling into chaos.
events.pleaseNote: Appropriate contains strong language and mature themes, including references to sexual violence, discussions of suicide, and racism.
